summary: Mapped the OSS D1/API/Console and Local SQLite/CLI identity seams plus the separate Enterprise PostgreSQL/Node/Helm repository required for additive user, organization, group, category, OTP, OIDC, and SCIM delivery.

evidence.ref: targeted repository reads, schema parity, typechecks, and live PostgreSQL migration/RLS probes

residual_risks: Email and SCIM remain feature-flagged off until an initial tenant_admin configures the organization.
Publishing the versioned OSS packages and OCI images is an external release action and is not performed by this repository-only implementation.
